regions: flash: the register table (names of the chip's registers)
RAM: the state at the last fault (pc, registers, the data stack)
RAM: IPSR of the interrupt being handled, for fault()
RAM: interrupt handlers (one xt per IRQ, IRQ!)
RAM: the error recovery point (ABORT, THROW)
RAM: kernel variables (STATE BASE >IN SOURCE HERE LATEST, the input line, WORD, HOLD)
RAM: the pointer to the kernel variables
RAM: characters dropped by the last accept
RAM: something printed on this line
RAM: free, then the return stack (rsp grows down from the top)
flash: the SAVE area (the dictionary SAVE wrote, restored at boot)
